raw_evidence_tuple.input_type: exactly 11 positional values, each type(value) is bytes; bytearray, memoryview, str, decoded object, subclass, path, URL, iterator, resolver, and any missing/extra position refuse before JSON parsing
raw_evidence_tuple.cardinality_and_variants: Eight signed positions are root PIS, phase PIS, ScopeIntent, CES, PEA, BVP, CAS, and selected admission. Bootstrap requires root and phase PIS bytes equal; scope-action/replay-pre-final require separate positions and phase PIS variant stage-consumer/replay-consumer. No other byte-identity rule is imposed.
raw_evidence_tuple.not_supplied: No IssuanceBasis, gate, ScopeAuthorization, document, PlannedCaptureSet, BVP plan payload, receipt, resolver, registry, broker, lifecycle object, or capture input is accepted; unlinked digest fields receive H syntax checking only.

dependency_boundary.verifier_imports: The only dskit.pipeline.trust import in dskit.production.verifier for this preflight is `from dskit.pipeline.trust import ReleaseKeyring, TrustedClock`. HistoricalStudyRevocations is defined in verifier.py; it is not imported from trust.py.
dependency_boundary.independence: The canonical parser/serializer below is implemented privately in verifier.py. It deliberately does not promise byte parity with a future private trust helper; both are separately pinned by focused tests and frozen trust.py remains untouched.

canonical_and_scalar_rules.parse: _parse_canonical(raw): require type(raw) is bytes; decode raw with UTF-8 strict; json.loads(text, parse_constant=_reject_constant, object_pairs_hook=_reject_duplicate_pairs), where _reject_constant always raises and _reject_duplicate_pairs raises unless every decoded object key occurs once. Recursively admit only dict with str keys, list, str, None, bool, int (with bool handled before int), and finite float; reject any other Python value. All later closed shapes reject null and float because no declared field admits them.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.serialize: _canonical_json_bytes(value): require the same recursive JSON domain, then json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False).encode('ascii'). _parse_canonical refuses unless this exact byte string equals raw. Thus escaped non-ASCII is ASCII `\u` spelling, object keys sort by that serializer, duplicate keys/non-finite constants refuse, and no private trust function is called.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.Obj: JSON object with exactly its listed keys; null/default/alias/extra/missing keys refuse.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.Arr[T]: JSON array with every element T and its named order/uniqueness rule; no rule is implicit.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.S: JSON string; empty is allowed only because ADR-0125 supplies no tighter local constraint.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.I: JSON integer with type(value) is int; bool, float, and coercion refuse.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.signature: S passed unchanged as the signature argument to ReleaseKeyring.verify. ADR-0125 and its public ABC give no signature codec, so this preflight invents no base64 rule.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.local_self: For an unsigned object, SHA-256(_canonical_json_bytes(the object with exactly its named self key removed)) equals that field. For every signed envelope, remove exactly its named self key and signature key; SHA-256 of that preimage equals self, and that same preimage is the keyring message.

sort_and_uniqueness.byte_comparator: B(a,b) compares two byte strings left-to-right as unsigned octets 0..255; at the first differing octet lower wins; if one is a complete prefix, the shorter wins; equal bytes tie. No decoded-Unicode, locale, code-point, or platform comparison is permitted.
sort_and_uniqueness.field_key: For a declared one-field sort key x, K(x)=_canonical_json_bytes(x). For a declared tuple (x1,...,xn), K=_canonical_json_bytes([x1,...,xn]) in that exact order. Sort ascending by B(K(left),K(right)). `strict` means each adjacent key has B<0, so the stated sort-key identity is unique. `complete` means compare complete canonical item bytes by B and strict means duplicate complete bytes refuse.

arrays.ScopeIntent.action_intents and ActionInt: strict (topological_position,action_id); separately exactly one each ActionId
arrays.ScopeIntent.replay_intents and ReplayInt: strict replay_id; exactly control and crash-restart
arrays.CAS.entries: ascending pair: first planned_entry_sha256 by B(K), then full canonical PlannedCaptureEntry bytes by B; equal full bytes refuse
arrays.converted CES PCEs: after conversion, sort by the exact CAS.entries pair before item-for-item comparison
arrays.all other arrays: No other array exists in a supplied closed schema; adding one refuses.

sort_and_uniqueness.non_ascii_case: Every stated sort RED includes strings z and U+00E9 (serialized as `\u00e9`) and proves the accepted order is the B/K byte order, not decoded string order.

suffix.composition: For each named envelope, its exact key set is its envelope keys plus these suffix keys, with that envelope's named self replacing named_self. No suffix key may be repeated in an envelope table; no other key is admitted.

signed_envelope_rules.common: not_before_ms <= issued_at_ms <= expires_at_ms. Call clock.now_ms exactly once, require type(result) is int, and apply that one instant inclusively to every envelope. Require keyring.verify(key.key_id,key.key_version,issued_at_ms,preimage,signature) is True and revocations.is_unrevoked(snapshot,key.key_id,key.key_version,now_ms) is True; false, non-bool, exception, unknown, unavailable, lazy lookup, or stale snapshot refuses.

profile_and_local_link_rules.select_scope_child_first: After all Scope child self-digests and set membership are valid but before any child-field comparison, derive common subject_ref from CES/PEA/BVP/CAS and require its complete canonical bytes equal. For ActionSubject select exactly one Scope.action_intents entry where action_id and action_intent_sha256 both equal subject fields. For ReplaySubject select exactly one Scope.replay_intents entry where replay_id and replay_intent_sha256 both equal subject fields. Zero or more than one matches refuses. Only this selected child is used below.
common: all eight signed envelopes have byte-equal study_id
Scope purpose equals CES, PEA, BVP, and CAS purpose; CES/PEA/BVP/CAS consumer_document_sha256 are equal; their complete subject_ref bytes are equal
CES/PEA/BVP/CAS consumer_document_contract_sha256 equal the selected Scope child consumer_document_contract_sha256
CES/PEA/BVP component_manifest_sha256 equal the selected Scope child component_manifest_sha256; CAS has no component_manifest_sha256 and no such comparison is made
CES/PEA/BVP/CAS published_input_set_sha256 equal phase PIS self
CES self equals PEA/BVP/CAS/selected-admission capture_expectation_set_sha256; PEA self equals BVP/CAS/selected-admission plan_evaluation_authorization_sha256

BVP self equals CAS/selected-admission broker_verified_plan_sha256; BVP plan_sha256 and planned_capture_set_sha256 equal selected-admission fields; BVP planned_capture_set_sha256 equals CAS planned_capture_set_sha256; CAS self equals selected-admission capture_admission_set_sha256
issued_at_ms is nondecreasing root PIS, phase PIS, Scope, CES, PEA, BVP, CAS, selected admission
bootstrap: phase PIS phase root-g1-g2 and bytes equal root PIS; CES/PEA phase bootstrap with ActionSubject
PEA authority_ref scope-intent-gate-set and its scope intent equals Scope self; CES/PEA PIS equals Scope published_input_set_sha256 and root PIS self
selected admission ActionExecutionAdmission whose action_id/action_intent_sha256 equal subject
scope_action: phase PIS stage-consumer; CES/PEA phase scope-action with ActionSubject
PEA authority_ref scope-authorization-action and intent equals subject; scope authorization remains H-only
selected admission ActionExecutionAdmission whose action_id/action_intent_sha256 equal subject; root PIS is not compared to phase PIS
replay_pre_final: phase PIS replay-consumer; CES/PEA phase replay-pre-final with ReplaySubject
PEA authority_ref scope-authorization-replay and intent equals subject; scope authorization remains H-only
selected admission FinalReplayAdmission whose replay_id/replay_intent_sha256 equal subject; root PIS is not compared to phase PIS
profile_and_local_link_rules.local_pis_ces_cas_projection: For each CES entry require exactly one phase-PIS entry with equal input_id and byte-equal complete PublishedInputEntry. Convert it to PlannedCaptureEntry by adding schema, common subject_ref, and computed planned_entry_sha256; then sort the converted PCEs by the exact CAS comparator and require item-for-item equality to CAS.entries, including cardinality. This proves P(CES)==P(CAS), not P(BVP).
profile_and_local_link_rules.root_pis_membership: For every root ActionIntent (both predecessor arrays empty), each root_published_input_id must identify exactly one root PIS entry by input_id. Root PIS strict input_id ordering independently makes duplicate entries refuse. Every nonroot has empty root_published_input_ids. This is local membership only, not receipt resolution.
profile_and_local_link_rules.bvp_limit: BVP.plan_sha256 and BVP.planned_capture_set_sha256 are H values and only directly equal supplied fields; no BVP payload, PCE, or preimage claim is made.

embedded_dag_rules: Scope action_intents and ActionIntentSet.entries are byte-identical; Scope action_intent_set_sha256 equals set self; complete set has each ActionId once.
Scope replay_intents and ReplayIntentSet.entries are byte-identical; Scope replay_intent_set_sha256 equals set self; complete set exactly control/crash-restart.

edge_set_bytes is canonical Arr[EdgeSetEntry] under the parser and exact byte comparator; SHA-256(edge_set_bytes)=Scope.edge_set_sha256. action_dag_sha256 remains H-only because ADR gives no exact local preimage.

The distinct predecessor_action_id projection equals predecessor_action_ids. Each predecessor is a different in-scope action with strictly smaller topological_position. Roots have empty predecessor IDs/refs; nonroots have empty root IDs.

Each predecessor-output InputContract has exactly one EdgeSetEntry with matching consumer action/binding and matching one predecessor ref tuple; every EdgeSetEntry has exactly one such contract/ref. A published-input contract has no EdgeSetEntry at its binding. source_ref remains S-only.

revocation_seam.abc: abstract is_unrevoked(snapshot_sha256: str, key_id: str, key_version: int, now_ms: int) -> bool
revocation_seam.argument_admission: The private factory receives exactly ReleaseKeyring, TrustedClock, and HistoricalStudyRevocations instances; callable, mapping, duck-typed, registry-selected, null, and data-selected substitutes refuse. Test doubles explicitly subclass their ABCs.
revocation_seam.snapshot_semantics: True means an authenticated immutable snapshot named exactly by snapshot_sha256 has no effective revocation for (key_id,key_version) at now_ms. Unknown/absent/invalid/unavailable/stale/lazy snapshot or any exception/non-built-in-True refuses. It performs no network/store read and is not durable authorization.
